annotations.title: How to book a flight with points

description:
Returns how to book a specific flight with points or miles, from AwardSecrets' award-chart and transfer-partner data: the loyalty programmes that can book the flight, the miles each charges one way, the best way to book it (fewest points once taxes and surcharges are counted), how credit card, hotel or airline points transfer to each programme (ratio, transfer time, points needed, any active transfer bonus and its end date), estimated taxes and surcharges, and the airline or programme sites where award seats can be checked.

Input: either question (the traveller's own words, e.g. 'ANA business class Chicago to Tokyo with Amex points') or structured fields: airline (2-letter IATA code of the airline to fly), origin and destination (3-letter airport codes), cabin, and optionally points_held (e.g. AMEX_MR, CHASE_UR, CITI_TY, CAPITAL_ONE, BILT, or a programme code such as AVIOS), date (YYYY-MM-DD) and passengers.

Output: answer is ready-to-display markdown; options holds the same facts as data. The prices are award-chart prices, not a live seat search: availability_checked is always false. Each option's price_state is fixed_chart, published_starting_price, off_peak or seasonal. answer_status is cabin_not_priced when the requested cabin is not priced (premium economy), in which case economy prices are returned; needs_clarification or off_topic when the question can't be answered as asked. listed_not_ranked names programmes that book the flight but price it by date.

airline.description: The airline to fly, one 2-letter IATA code (e.g. NH, BA, QF).

date.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD (picks the season on seasonal charts).

points_held.description: Points the traveller has: AMEX_MR, CHASE_UR, CITI_TY, CAPITAL_ONE, BILT, MAX_MILES, ROVE_MILES, or programme codes (AVIOS, AEROPLAN, FLYING_BLUE...).

question.description: The traveller's question in words. Use this OR the fields below.

name: how_to_book_with_points

charged.description: false for free answers and for any answer_status other than ok.

free.description: true when answered without a key (free tier).

answer_status.description: ok: priced in the cabin asked for. cabin_not_priced: we don't price that cabin (premium economy); options are ECONOMY, offered as an alternative. needs_clarification / off_topic: answer is a question or a one-line reply. Only ok is charged.

availability_checked.description: Always false: award-chart prices, not a live seat check.

fields.description: How the question was read (airlines, origin, destination, cabin, points_held...).

items.description: The answer for one airline the traveller could fly.

best.description: The best way: fewest points once taxes and surcharges count.

oneOf.description: One way to book: a loyalty programme and what it costs in its miles.

chart_as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the date we hold for this programme's chart: the date it took effect, or the date we read it from the programme's own pages.

price_state.description: What kind of number miles is. Only fixed_chart is the chart's price for any date; never present a starting or off-peak price as a quote.

transfer_amounts_at.description: Which price the transfer amounts are worked out on, when not the only one.

transfers.description: How the traveller's own points reach it: points already in a programme first, then card transfers.

condition.description: When the path only works under a condition (linked accounts).

kind.description: linked_account_move: Avios moved between the traveller's own linked accounts (British Airways, Iberia, Aer Lingus, Qatar, Finnair); conditional, see condition.

listed_not_ranked.description: Programmes that book it but whose price we don't stand behind (e.g. British Airways Avios).

items.description: One way to book: a loyalty programme and what it costs in its miles.

chart_as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the date we hold for this programme's chart: the date it took effect, or the date we read it from the programme's own pages.

price_state.description: What kind of number miles is. Only fixed_chart is the chart's price for any date; never present a starting or off-peak price as a quote.

transfer_amounts_at.description: Which price the transfer amounts are worked out on, when not the only one.

transfers.description: How the traveller's own points reach it: points already in a programme first, then card transfers.

condition.description: When the path only works under a condition (linked accounts).

kind.description: linked_account_move: Avios moved between the traveller's own linked accounts (British Airways, Iberia, Aer Lingus, Qatar, Finnair); conditional, see condition.

priced_by_date.description: Programmes that price this flight by date: no fixed price.

priced_cabin.description: The cabin the miles are for. Differs from cabin when we don't price the cabin asked for; null when the airline has no such cabin (Scoot has no business or first class).
